deploy-bot: [Deploy] Starting staging deploy
service: orchestrator
env: staging
tag: release-2026-03-20-1
commit: 0a1b2c3d
initiator: ci/cd-pipeline

kate: rolling, watching smoke. starting synthetic checks now

javier: FYI can we pin model-reranker v2.3.1 as a fallback if errors spike? last time auto-fallback caused inference mismatch

sasha: noted. smoke tests running: median latency 120ms, error-rate 0.0% so far

ops-oncall: opening a 30m watch window; if 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 1.8s, trigger rollback plan A

kate: applying canary weight 10% -> 100% over 3 mins

deploy-bot: canary traffic shift to 10% complete

javier: seeing a few 503s from orchestrator-worker-3, digging into logs: OOM on decode path

sasha: ack, evicting that pod and draining. re-route traffic off host-orch-3

kate: hold full shift, pausing at 10% while we confirm pod stability

deploy-bot: pause reason: health-check failures on host-orch-3

javier: restarted with increased heap, new pod ID host-orch-3b. tailing logs now

sasha: re-running smoke: p95 200ms, error-rate 0.02% — within thresholds, recommend continue

ops-oncall: ✅ from me, proceed when ready

kate: continuing to 50% now

deploy-bot: traffic shift to 50% complete

kate: dashboards look good, no reranker metric regressions, throughput steady

deploy-bot: finalizing traffic shift to 100%

deploy-bot: Deploy complete: staging | service=orchestrator | tag=release-2026-03-20-1 | commit=0a1b2c3d | duration=9m32s | notes=canary paused briefly for health-check, resumed

sasha: running post-deploy smoke and publishing release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/release-2026-03-20-1

javier: request: pin previous stable tag release-2026-03-16-4 as fallback for 24h (helps quick rollback if any delayed regressions)

deploy-bot: pinned fallback release-2026-03-16-4 for 24h

kate: closing the active watch window, moving to passive monitoring for 2h

ops-oncall: will monitor alerts, will escalate on anomalies :eyes:

kate: thanks team :rocket:
